name: Frutiger Space
detailed_description:
DISCLAIMER: Frutiger Space is currently under development, and much of what you see is still a work in progress. If something appears incomplete or wonky, don't worry, it's either being updated or will be fixed in future updates.
Stay connected for updates through our official channels! (linked on the right)

An Overview

Frutiger Space is a social multiplayer game set in a utopian universe, reminiscent of the aesthetic of the internet's heyday. it’s a place where everyone can feel at home: whether you're exploring, playing minigames, accessorizing your Meeple, getting in on some secrets, or just rocking out to music bobbing in a bubble, there's always something to do!

Chat with Friends

Frutiger Space carries the spirit of early 2000s social games, with the goal of creating a place where players can connect, form new friendships, and be part of a warm and inclusive community!

A World of Frutiger Aero Subgenres

Each area in the map has its own style, influenced by various Frutiger Aero subgenres, such as Frutiger Eco, Frutiger Aqua, Frutiger Metro, Technozen and more!

Meeple Customization

Your Meeple can be personalised with a huge selection of cosmetics. Express your personality with unique outfits, stylish hats, and accessories. You can purchase new things with Frutiger Orbs, which are obtained by playing minigames, completing tasks, or simply exploring the world to discover its riches.

Activities and Minigames

Frutiger Space also features a collection of minigames and activities to have fun with!
Of course, no grinding and sweating. The main ones include:

  • Dolphin Racing

  • Watergun Battles

  • Fruit Collecting

  • And much more to come!

reviews:
